TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

The fixture observatory opens its dome only when the wind speed is below 25 kilometres per hour.
Observers log the dome status every hour.

The main telescope is recalibrated on the first night of every month. Calibration takes about
ninety minutes and is recorded in the calibration journal.

Visitors are welcome on Fridays. Visitors may not touch the telescope controls.
